brand_identity.name: Portfolio
brand_identity.core_archetype: Soft editorial personal site — quiet confidence, generous whitespace, product-first work grid

target_audience.primary: Hiring managers, founders, and collaborators reviewing product / design / engineering work
target_audience.device_profile: Desktop-first sidebar layout; stacks to single column on mobile
target_audience.emotional_tone: Calm, approachable, precise — never loud or decorative

visual_symbols: Circular profile avatar with soft drop shadow
Soft white project cards with subtle elevation
Muted gray tag pills on project cards
Minimal social icon row (X, LinkedIn, GitHub, Dribbble)

color_system.theme_mode: Light only (no dark mode for v1)
rules: Never use pure black #000000 for text — use stone-900 (#1C1917).
Page background is warm stone-100 (#F5F5F4); cards and sidebar content sit on white.
No gradients, no neon accents, no colored brand CTAs in v1.
Shadows stay soft and diffuse — elevation via blur, not hard borders.
All text contrast must meet WCAG AA 4.5:1 on the stone background.

typography.font_pair_rationale: Single sans family keeps the UI quiet and product-like; weight and size create hierarchy instead of mixed typefaces.
forbidden: Uppercase tracking-wide labels except optional section micro-labels
Font sizes larger than text-3xl on the homepage

spacing_and_layout.max_content_width: max-w-5xl on the work grid column
rules: Sidebar stays sticky on desktop; collapses above the work grid on mobile.
Project cards are 1 column on mobile, 2 columns from md up.
Internal card padding is p-5 sm:p-6 — never let text touch the card edge.
Leave generous vertical rhythm between avatar, bio, socials, and nav (space-y-6+).

elevation_and_surfaces.tag_pill: inline-flex rounded-full bg-stone-100 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-stone-600
rules: Prefer soft multi-layer shadows over 1px borders for cards.
Use ring-white on the avatar so it separates from the stone page bg.
Do not add colored hover fills on cards — only lift + shadow.

sidebar.nav_style: vertical list, calm text links, active = stone-900

project_card.tags: wrap row of soft gray pills below description

homepage_blueprint.layout: Two-column desktop shell: sticky profile sidebar + Recent Work grid

section_sidebar.name: Your Name
section_sidebar.bio: Short 2–3 sentence bio describing focus and craft.
section_sidebar.socials: Icon-only links opening in new tabs
